requirements.title: The application shall display a current-streak badge on every habit row

vision.paraphrase: The streak number is the visual hero of every row — always present.

conops.paraphrase: A brand-new habit renders with streak 0, so the badge exists from the first row.

requirements.title: The application shall compute the current streak as the count of consecutive completed local calendar days ending today, when today is completed

vision.paraphrase: The normative streak rule: consecutive days ending today when today is completed.

conops.paraphrase: Checking today off extends the visible run to include today.

requirements.title: The application shall keep the streak visible without reset when today is not yet completed but yesterday is

vision.paraphrase: The yesterday-grace clause: an unchecked day still shows the streak until the day truly ends.

conops.paraphrase: Opening the app the next morning still shows yesterday's streak before the check-in.

requirements.title: The application shall display a streak of 0 when neither today nor yesterday is completed

vision.paraphrase: The zero clause of the streak rule: a missed day honestly resets the count.

conops.paraphrase: The user who skipped days sees 0 — the number tells the truth, no guilt mechanics.

requirements.title: The application shall update the streak badge immediately when "Done today" is toggled, without a page reload

vision.paraphrase: Goal G3: checking today off updates the streak immediately.

conops.paraphrase: The badge moves 0 to 1 in the already-rendered page — instant feedback.

requirements.title: The application shall recompute a restored habit's streak from its preserved completion history

vision.paraphrase: Archive/restore preserves completions, so streak logic applies unchanged after restore.

conops.paraphrase: A restored habit shows its history-derived streak — alive if yesterday or today counts, else 0.
